verdict.rationale: ROS 2 states it covers everything 'from drivers to state-of-the-art algorithms', and its base install ships message packages. Topics are documented for streaming sensor data, with a predefined sensor-data QoS profile. Community users corroborate the large ecosystem of existing ROS nodes and drivers, and say shared message definitions remove glue code. Missing for 10: no evidence naming specific camera, lidar, IMU or GPS drivers; no documentation of the standard sensor message types for these devices; no hands-on bring-up reports for these sensor classes.
